facts.label: Planos e previsões
facts.sub: Use present continuous para planos combinados, going to para intenções e will para dúvidas, ofertas e previsões: I’m meeting him. I’m going to buy a dress. Maybe I’ll go.

facts.label: Combinado
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para um plano combinado: I’m meeting my cousin on Saturday. I’m flying on Friday. Em geral há dia, hora ou pessoa definidos.

facts.label: Plano
facts.sub: Use going to para uma intenção ou plano pensado: I’m going to buy a new dress. We’re going to see a concert. Também mostra uma previsão com sinais claros.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Present continuous can show a fixed plan.
Maybe I’ll go shows a sure plan.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Present continuous can show a fixed plan. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Going to shows an intention. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Maybe I’ll go shows a sure plan. → Falso (It shows doubt.)

pages.title: A busy cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm Thursday afternoon in a busy cafe in Atlanta. The machine hisses, and cups clink on the counter. Yan sits by the window with a notebook. His friend Luisa arrives with a big bag. They both have plans for the next weeks. Yan asks about the weekend.
“Luisa, are you doing anything this weekend?” says Yan. “Maybe we’ll go to the lake. I’m not sure yet.” says Luisa. “I’m meeting my cousin on Saturday. We’re going to see a concert.” says Yan.

opts: I meet my cousin on Saturday next.

I’m meeting my cousin on Saturday.
items.why: For a fixed plan, use am/is/are + -ing.

opts: Maybe I go to the lake.
Maybe I going to the lake.
Maybe I’ll go to the lake.
items.why: After maybe, use will for doubt.

opts: I’m going to buying a dress.
I’m going to buy a dress.
items.why: After going to, use the base verb.

opts: I think it will crowded tomorrow.
I think it is crowded tomorrow.
I think it will be crowded tomorrow.
items.why: For a prediction, use will + be.

Escolha a frase mais natural. → Maybe I’ll go to the lake.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → I’m going to buy a dress.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → I think it will be crowded tomorrow.
